value.rationale: The conditional variance of a standard two-sample rank statistic, given the classical fixed-content runs statistic, exhibits an exact strict alternating profile despite zero covariance. This is a global conditional dependence structural law and provides concrete, nontrivial finite-null calibrations for joint or stratified nonparametric procedures; it is not recoverable from the separate marginal variance formulas alone.
